sloka: असुरो न्यपतत् भूमौ पर्यस्त इव पर्वतः ।ते तु तस्मिन् निर् उच्छ्वासे वानरा जित काशिनः ॥४-४८-२२॥
transliteration: asuro nyapatat bhūmau paryasta iva parvataḥ ।te tu tasmin nir ucchvāse vānarā jita kāśinaḥ ॥4-48-22॥

translations.english: He breathed his last, and the monkeys who won went searching almost all over the mountain caves.
